decisionRequired: How the governed runtime should obtain git facts without widening the daemon environment. Option C is the one that matches existing architecture: the HOST already resolves an absolute node.exe rather than relying on PATH (resolve_development_node), so it could resolve git.exe the same way and pass that single absolute path to the daemon. Option A (add PATH to the daemon env) undoes deliberate hardening. Option B (derive git facts in the Rust host and hand them to the gate) moves a governance input across a trust boundary and needs its own review. Whichever is chosen is SUBSTANTIVE source, so the evidence subject must be re-established and the desktop proof re-run against it afterwards.
